Angels.description: A white flying pack built around Angels that grow each other as more of them land on the battlefield.
Angels.plan: Get Giada or Youthful Valkyrie down early, then follow up with more Angels so each one arrives bigger, and win in the air while Pacifism handles a ground threat.

variants.1: Adds Serra Angel, with Destroy Evil and Light of Hope for flexible answers and Celestial Enforcer to tap blockers
variants.2: Adds Herald of War and Stalwart Valkyrie, plus Rally of Wings for a big air swing and Angelic Edict as removal

Armed.description: A white equipment pack: small soldiers that pick up weapons and armor to become much bigger threats.
Armed.plan: Play cheap creatures, suit them up, and attack; Danitha Capashen makes the gear cheaper and Fencing Ace gets double value from every bonus.

variants.1: Mace of the Valiant and Valkyrie's Sword, with Starnheim Courser to discount artifacts
variants.2: Stone Haven Outfitter, Plate Armor and Hexgold Hoverwings, with Militant Inquisitor
variants.3: Maul of the Skyclaves and Flutterfox for flying, plus Resistance Reunited and Trusty Retriever
variants.4: Godsend and Plate Armor, with Thopter Architect for evasion and Deadly Riposte as removal

Beasts.description: A green pack of big Beasts that get cheaper, bigger and draw you cards as the herd grows.
Beasts.plan: Land Woodland Liege or Advocate of the Beast early, then cast Beasts that draw cards and grow; Slinza makes the rest cheaper and Time to Feed clears the way.

variants.1: Obstinate Baloth and Spined Tyrranax, with Explore and Gift of the Gargantuan to find lands and creatures
variants.2: Garruk, Caller of Beasts and Garruk's Packleader for card draw, plus Baloth Gorger and Bushwhack

Bloody.description: A red Vampire pack that makes Blood tokens and turns discarding into an advantage.
Bloody.plan: Attack early and often, use Blood tokens to swap bad cards for new ones, and finish with haste threats and Soul Sear clearing the biggest blocker.

variants.1: Madness focus with Anje's Ravager, Incorrigible Youths and Abandon Reason
variants.2: Markov Blademaster and Markov Enforcer, with Blood Hypnotist to stop blockers
variants.3: Scion of Opulence and Markov Warlord, with Vampiric Fury and Blood Feud
variants.4: Falkenrath Marauders flying in, plus Voldaren Ambusher and Neonate's Rush

Bookworms.description: A blue card-draw pack where creatures get stronger whenever you draw more than one card in a turn.
Bookworms.plan: Keep drawing extra cards to grow your creatures and fill your hand, then let Syr Elenora become huge while Starlight Snare locks down a threat.

variants.1: Overflowing Insight, Trial of Knowledge with Cartouche of Knowledge, and Shore Keeper
variants.2: Teferi's Ageless Insight to double draws, plus Muse Drake, Witching Well and Uncomfortable Chill
variants.3: Sphinx of Enlightenment, Thopter Mechanic and Omen of the Sea
variants.4: Nadir Kraken and Tolarian Kraken reward every draw, with Opt and Soul Read

Burning.description: A red burn pack full of damage spells and creatures that ping the opponent whenever you cast them.
Burning.plan: Cast cheap burn to clear blockers and hit the opponent, letting Firebrand Archer and Chandra's Spitfire add extra damage; Rionya copies your best creature on a big spell turn.

Chaos.description: A five-color pack of cascade spells and mana fixing, where each big spell casts a free bonus spell.
Chaos.plan: Use Terramorphic Expanse, Ash Barrens, Druid of the Anima and Chromatic Lantern to fix your mana, then cascade into free spells for a big swing in value.

Clerics.description: A black Cleric pack that brings creatures back from the graveyard and gains life along the way.
Clerics.plan: Trade creatures freely, then use Bonecaller Cleric and Revoke Demise to bring your best ones back; Dark Bargain keeps the cards flowing.

variants.1: Taborax, Nullpriest of Oblivion and Eerie Soultender, with Agonizing Syphon
variants.2: Taborax, Entomber Exarch and Elderfang Disciple for discard, plus Severed Strands
variants.3: Vito drains on lifegain, and Dark Supplicant can fetch Scion of Darkness
variants.4: Vito and Priest of Forgotten Gods, with Extinguish the Light and Stronghold Confessor

Copied.description: A red spells pack where instants and sorceries make tokens, pump creatures and get copied.
Copied.plan: Fill the board with Young Pyromancer tokens and pump Kiln Fiend by casting cheap spells; target Zada with a pump spell to copy it onto your whole team.

variants.1: Cheap card-drawing spells like Crimson Wisps and Renegade Tactics, plus Guttersnipe and Spellgorger Weird
variants.2: Two Ancestral Anger, Charmbreaker Devils and Uncaged Fury for double strike

Dinner.description: A green Food pack that makes Food tokens and spends them for life, cards and huge creatures.
Dinner.plan: Build up Food, then sacrifice it for a 7/7 Giant, a +5/+5 pump or extra cards from Trail of Crumbs; Hurska turns the life you gain into extra damage.

Dinosaurs.description: A green pack of big Dinosaurs with ramp spells to cast them early.
Dinosaurs.plan: Ramp with Rampant Growth, find Dinosaurs with Commune with Dinosaurs, and stomp in with tramplers; enough power on the board makes Ghalta nearly free.

variants.1: Drover of the Mighty for mana, Armored Kincaller, Savage Stomp and Giant Growth
variants.2: Topiary Stomper and Cherished Hatchling, with Tail Swipe and Predator's Strike

Dragons.description: A red flying pack of Dragons, with cost reducers and spells that get better when a Dragon is around.
Dragons.plan: Curve into Dragons in the air, use Dragonlord's Servant to cast them sooner, and land Lathliss so every new Dragon brings a 5/5 friend.

variants.1: Rapacious Dragon for Treasure, Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind for haste, and Bathe in Dragonfire
variants.2: Sarkhan, Fireblood and Hellkite Whelp, with Sarkhan's Rage as a finisher

Drowned.description: A blue graveyard pack that mills cards and gets value from what lands there.
Drowned.plan: Fill your graveyard early with Wall of Lost Thoughts and Screaming Swarm, then cash in with Sudden Insight, flashback and Neerdiv's card draw.

variants.1: Shipwreck Dowser, Stitched Drake and Organ Hoarder, with Silent Departure and Ipnu Rivulet
variants.2: Cackling Counterpart, Waker of Waves and Cruel Witness, with Towering-Wave Mystic

Elves.description: A green Elf pack that ramps mana and swarms the board with Elves that pump each other.
Elves.plan: Use cheap mana Elves to go wide fast, then cast Overcome for a big trampling attack; Dionus grows your Elves each time they tap.

variants.1: Leaf-Crowned Visionary as the lord, plus Thornweald Archer and Band Together
variants.2: Elvish Archdruid, Dwynen's Elite and Might of the Masses
variants.3: Marwyn, the Nurturer and Llanowar Visionary for more mana
variants.4: Tyvar Kell and Voice of the Woods, with Paradise Druid

Enchanted.description: A white enchantments pack where Auras and enchantment creatures trigger bonus effects as they enter.
Enchanted.plan: Play an enchantment each turn to make Psemilla's Nymph tokens and give Flutterfox flying, with Banishing Light removing the biggest threat.

variants.1: Constellation tricks from Captivating Unicorn and Favored of Iroas, plus Spirited Companion
variants.2: Cartouche of Solidarity, Cage of Hands and Nyx-Fleece Ram
variants.3: Lifegain build with Nykthos Paragon, Serra's Embrace and Starfield Mystic
variants.4: Archon of Sun's Grace makes flying Pegasi, with Angelic Gift and Favored of Iroas

Encounter.description: A green +1/+1 counters pack where creatures keep growing and many cards reward having counters.
Encounter.plan: Spread +1/+1 counters early, then let Mowu and counter-doubling effects turn your team into a trampling force; Jiang Yanggu makes counters into mana.

variants.1: Forgotten Ancient and Servant of the Scale, with Biogenic Upgrade and Duskshell Crawler
variants.2: Oran-Rief Ooze and Jungle Delver, with Invigorating Surge and Stony Strength
variants.3: Rishkar, Peema Renegade and Biogenic Upgrade, with Reckless Amplimancer
variants.4: Primeval Bounty and Quirion Beastcaller, with Armorcraft Judge for cards

Explorers.description: A green Scout pack that searches for lands, explores and turns extra land drops into a bigger army.
Explorers.plan: Hit every land drop with Explore and Go Forth, then attack with Braulios, whose size equals your land count and who draws a card each time he swings.

variants.1: Realm Seekers and Tireless Provisioner, with Ainok Guide and Adventurous Impulse
variants.2: Clue value from Tireless Tracker and Ulvenwald Mysteries, plus Primeval Herald
variants.3: Tokens build with Somberwald Beastmaster, Briarbridge Tracker and Woodland Champion
variants.4: Explore creatures: Jadelight Ranger, Merfolk Branchwalker and Ixalli's Diviner

Fun Guys.description: A green Fungus pack that floods the board with 1/1 Saproling tokens and pumps them all at once.
Fun Guys.plan: Make Saprolings with Saproling Migration and Spore Swarm, grow them with Sporecrown Thallid, and let Shroofus multiply any that connect.

variants.1: Overwhelm and Might of the Masses as finishers, plus Tukatongue Thallid and Spore Crawler
variants.2: Verdeloth the Ancient and Undercellar Myconid, with Overcome and For the Family

Ghastly.description: A black pack that profits whenever creatures die, with sacrifice outlets and morbid rewards.
Ghastly.plan: Trade creatures and sacrifice them on purpose to draw cards with Morbid Opportunist and drain with Falkenrath Noble, using Tragic Slip as cheap removal.

variants.1: Harvester of Souls, Murder and Wakedancer, with Village Rites
variants.2: Bloodgift Demon, Gnawing Zombie and Typhoid Rats, with Defenestrate
variants.3: Reaper from the Abyss and Morkrut Behemoth, with Deadly Dispute and Murder
variants.4: Army of the Damned for a swarm of Zombies, plus Shambling Ghast and Crawl from the Cellar

Giddyap.description: A white pack of Unicorns, Pegasi and Horses with plenty of lifegain.
Giddyap.plan: Fly over with Pegasi and gain life to grow Celestial Unicorn; Thurid copies each Unicorn, Pegasus and Horse you cast and pumps the rest.

Goblins.description: A red Goblin pack that makes lots of 1/1 tokens and gets damage from going wide.
Goblins.plan: Flood the board with Goblin tokens from Krenko's Command and Goblin Surprise, attack with General Kreat for more, and finish with Volley Veteran or a team pump.

variants.1: Dropkick Bomber and Battle Cry Goblin, with Goblin Researcher and Brute Strength
variants.2: Goblin Goliath and Dropkick Bomber, with Goblin Arsonist and Mogg Flunkies
variants.3: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin and Beetleback Chief, with Scavenged Blade
variants.4: Goblin Rabblemaster and Fanatical Firebrand, with Fire Prophecy

Grave Robbers.description: A black graveyard pack that mills its own deck to fuel creature recursion.
Grave Robbers.plan: Mill early with Gorging Vulture, then bring creatures back over and over with Eternal Taskmaster and Revoke Demise until the opponent runs out of answers.

variants.1: Gorex, the Tombshell and Graveblade Marauder, with Grave Strength and Murder
variants.2: Gorex, Doomed Necromancer and Dusk Mangler, with Necrotic Wound
variants.3: Isareth the Awakener and Dreadhound, with Persistent Specimen and Memorial to Folly
variants.4: Liliana, Death's Majesty and Isareth, with Goremand

Healers.description: A white lifegain pack where gaining life grows your creatures and powers up your Angels.
Healers.plan: Gain a little life every turn to put counters on Ajani's Pridemate and Qala, then attack with a growing team while Angel of Vitality adds extra life.

variants.1: Speaker of the Heavens, Angel of Mercy and Faith's Fetters
variants.2: Valkyrie Harbinger and Speakeasy Server, with Take Up the Shield
variants.3: Righteous Valkyrie and Banisher Priest, with Angel of Mercy
variants.4: Felidar Sovereign and Rhox Faithmender for a 40-life win, plus Faith's Fetters

Heroes.description: A white pack built around heroic creatures that grow stronger or gain extra effects whenever you target them with your own spells.
Heroes.plan: Play cheap heroic creatures early, then cast pump spells and auras on them so each spell also adds counters or triggers a bonus, building one or two big attackers.

variants.1: more combat tricks (Dauntless Onslaught, Moment of Heroism) plus Akroan Skyguard and Tethmos High Priest to bring back small creatures
variants.2: more tempo: Ojutai Exemplars, Elite Skirmisher and Repel the Darkness tap down blockers, and Gird for Battle adds counters

Icky.description: A black pack of insects, worms and other creepy-crawlies that are happy to be sacrificed for value.
Icky.plan: Make extra bodies with Wriggling Grub and Fumulus, then sacrifice them to pump Nantuko Husk or Devouring Swarm and to fuel removal like Eaten Alive.

variants.1: more aggressive: Fretwork Colony and Swarm of Bloodflies grow, Village Rites turns a sacrifice into cards, Durable Coilbug comes back
variants.2: grindier: Endless Cockroaches returns to hand, Virus Beetle forces a discard, plus Torment of Scarabs and Morkrut Necropod

Illusions.description: A blue pack of Illusion creatures that are cheap and evasive but often fragile, backed by a lord that makes them stronger and hard to target.
Illusions.plan: Land Lord of the Unreal to make your Illusions bigger and hexproof, then fly or slip past blockers while instants and sorceries make more Bird Illusions with Murmuring Mystic.

Inventive.description: A blue artifact pack full of Thopters, Constructs and gadgets that reward you for keeping lots of artifacts on the battlefield.
Inventive.plan: Fill the board with cheap artifacts and Thopter tokens, pump them with Chief of the Foundry, and use the artifact count to discount or power up your bigger threats.

variants.1: Thopter engine: Sai, Master Thopterist and Whirlermaker, plus Filigree Attendant, Gearseeker Serpent and bounce from Blink of an Eye
variants.2: Sai and Shimmer Dragon lead, with Fireshrieker, Treasure Keeper, Malfunction and Universal Solvent
variants.3: affinity payoffs: Thought Monitor, Thoughtcast and Myr Enforcer get cheap, with Padeem and Patchwork Automaton
variants.4: Padeem protects your artifacts, with Treasure Keeper, Guardian Idol, Shardless Outlander and Blink of an Eye

Landfall.description: A green pack whose creatures get bigger or trigger bonuses every time a land enters the battlefield under your control.
Landfall.plan: Make your land drop every turn (Evolving Wilds and Sutina give extra drops) and attack with landfall creatures while they are pumped, using Bite Down to clear blockers.

variants.1: ramp and power: Lotus Cobra, Harrow, Undergrowth Champion, Baloth Woodcrasher and Skyclave Pick-Axe
variants.2: value and life gain: Ancient Greenwarden, Retreat to Kazandu, Kazandu Nectarpot, Territorial Scythecat and Krosan Tusker
variants.3: +1/+1 counters: Scythecat Cub, Territorial Scythecat, Murasa Ranger and Retreat to Kazandu, plus Cliffhaven Kitesail for flying
variants.4: Scythecat Cub and Baloth Woodcrasher, with Sporemound tokens, Groundswell, Grazing Gladehart and Skyclave Pick-Axe

Legion.description: A white go-wide pack that floods the board with small Human and Soldier tokens.
Legion.plan: Make lots of creatures with Raise the Alarm, Ancestral Blade and Adeline, then pump the whole team with Dauntless Unity or Dawnwing Marshal for a big swing.

variants.1: Make a Stand for a protected alpha strike, plus Argivian Phalanx, Search Party Captain and Pacifism
variants.2: convoke: Triplicate Spirits, Venerated Loxodon and Conclave Tribunal, plus Defend the Campus and Memorial to Glory

Modified.description: A green pack about modified creatures: ones carrying +1/+1 counters, Auras or Equipment.
Modified.plan: Put counters, Auras and Equipment on your creatures to unlock bonuses like trample and extra mana, then push damage through with Kodama of the West Tree ramping you each hit.

Ne'er-do-wells.description: A black pack of Rogues and thieves that sneak in attacks, draw cards and pocket Treasure.
Ne'er-do-wells.plan: Make an attacker hard to block with Thieves' Tools, give deathtouch with Rev, and turn hits into cards and Treasure while black removal clears the way.

variants.1: more removal: Murder and Serpent Assassin, plus Midnight Assassin and Pilfering Imp in the air
variants.2: Rogue and mill focus: Thieves' Guild Enforcer, Expedition Skulker and Balustrade Spy, with Grim Bounty and Bloodtithe Collector

Nefarious.description: A black pack that trades your own life total for cards, removal and power.
Nefarious.plan: Pay life freely with Dark Confidant, Read the Bones and Infernal Grasp to stay ahead on cards, then cash it in with Vilis drawing cards and Vampire Scrivener growing.

Ninjas.description: A blue pack of cheap, sneaky attackers and Ninjas that swap in when an attack goes unblocked.
Ninjas.plan: Attack with small evasive creatures, then use ninjutsu to trade an unblocked one for a Ninja that draws cards or bounces a blocker, and replay the returned creature.

Of the Coast.description: A blue pack of crabs, starfish and turtles: sturdy, high-toughness creatures that hold the shore.
Of the Coast.plan: Stall the ground with tough blockers and tap down threats, draw a fistful with Plagon, then win by having creatures deal damage equal to their toughness.

variants.1: Kapsho Kitefins taps creatures, plus Omen of the Sea, Purple-Crystal Crab and Yarok's Wavecrasher to reuse enter effects
variants.2: more flyers and spells: Azure Drake, Glimmerbell, Opt and Shipwreck Dowser

Prideful.description: A white Cat pack of efficient, aggressive creatures and a pair of Cat lords.
Prideful.plan: Curve out with cheap Cats, pump them with King of the Pride and Leonin Scimitar, and keep attacking while Brimaz adds tokens and removal handles blockers.

Snakes.description: A black pack of Snakes and Gorgons where nearly everything has deathtouch.
Snakes.plan: Make every combat bad for your opponent with deathtouch creatures and tricks, drain with Hooded Blightfang on each attack, and pick off damaged creatures with Vraska's Finisher.

Soaring.description: A blue flying pack of Drakes, Birds and Faeries that rewards attacking through the air.
Soaring.plan: Get several flyers out, pump them with Cynette, and draw extra cards with Tide Skimmer each time you attack with two or more.

variants.1: Windreader Sphinx and Warden of Evos Isle, with Waterkin Shaman, Winged Words, Gust of Wind and Uncomfortable Chill
variants.2: Cavalier of Gales, Cartouche of Knowledge with Trial of Knowledge, Owl Familiar and Majestic Metamorphosis
variants.3: Mu Yanling planeswalker, Windstorm Drake, Cloudkin Seer, Malcator's Watcher and Thopter Mechanic
variants.4: Faeries: Sprite Noble and Stolen by the Fae, plus Air Elemental, Faerie Seer and Nightveil Sprite

Stalwart.description: A white +1/+1 counters pack whose creatures spread counters around and reward the ones that carry them.
Stalwart.plan: Put counters on your creatures early, use Urdnan to give countered attackers first strike, and remove blockers with Banishing Light and Swift Response.

variants.1: Ajani, Adversary of Tyrants and Generous Pup, with Angelic Cub, Gavony Silversmith, Patron of the Valiant and Squad Captain
variants.2: Basri's Lieutenant and Basri's Solidarity, with Star Pupil, Lightwalker, Battlefield Promotion and Cave of Temptation
variants.3: support: Relief Captain, Expedition Raptor, Jubilant Mascot and Shoulder to Shoulder, plus Generous Pup
variants.4: mentor and team counters: Light of the Legion, Mikaeus, the Lunarch, Parhelion Patrol and Sunhome Stalwart

Stoked.description: A red pack of heroic attackers and cheap spells that target your own creatures.
Stoked.plan: Pump a heroic creature like Cleon or Arena Athlete with Hearts on Fire and friends to stop blockers and add damage, using Roil Eruption to clear the way or finish the game.

variants.1: Frontline Heroism copies pump spells, plus Twinferno, Uncaged Fury, Kiln Fiend and Scholar of Combustion
variants.2: Dreadhorde Arcanist recasts spells, plus Hero of the Games, Unleash Fury, Coordinated Assault and Kiln Fiend
variants.3: Mirrorwing Dragon and Young Pyromancer, with Frontline Heroism, Akroan Crusader and Twinferno
variants.4: Goblin Dark-Dwellers and Weaver of Lightning, with Young Pyromancer, Infuriate and Crimson Wisps

Surprise!.description: A blue flash pack that does most of its work at instant speed, during your opponent's turn.
Surprise!.plan: Hold mana up, then flash in creatures and Auras as blockers or at end of turn, growing Brineborn Cutthroat and triggering Stinging Lionfish while you play off-turn.

variants.1: Thryx, the Sudden Storm, with Chrome Prowler, Capture Sphere, Slimebind, Crystacean and Wind Strider
variants.2: Voracious Greatshark counters a creature, plus Thryx, Pestermite, Naiad of Hidden Coves and Starlit Mantle
variants.3: Venser, Shaper Savant and Supreme Will, plus Pestermite, Breaching Hippocamp and Naiad of Hidden Coves
variants.4: Venser and Wavebreak Hippocamp, with Soul Read, Vexing Gull and Aven Reedstalker

Too Many.description: A red pack about having more than you should: Goblin tokens, paired legends and doubled damage.
Too Many.plan: Flood the board with Goblin tokens and cheap attackers, then turn it into lethal with Goblin Surprise, burn and Fiendish Duo doubling the damage your opponent takes.

Treasures.description: A black sacrifice pack where creatures dying turns into Treasure tokens, cards and life drain.
Treasures.plan: Trade off and sacrifice creatures to Pitiless Plunderer, Ruthless Knave and Deadly Dispute, using the Treasure to ramp, draw and recast Reassembling Skeleton.

variants.1: Bastion of Remembrance drains on each death, with Ruthless Technomancer and Grim Bounty
variants.2: harder removal: Contract Killing, Powerstone Fracture and Dusk Mangler, plus Vault of Whispers

Vampires.description: A black Vampire pack that drains life, gains it back and makes Blood tokens to filter cards.
Vampires.plan: Gain life a little at a time with lifelink Vampires, use it to fuel Nazar's card draw, and grind out the board with Bleed Dry and Blood Fountain.

variants.1: Sangromancer and Bloodtithe Collector, with Skymarch Bloodletter, Gift of Fangs, Urge to Feed and Vampire of the Dire Moon
variants.2: Crossway Troublemakers and Sanctum Seeker, with Bloodthirsty Aerialist, Creeping Bloodsucker and Urge to Feed
variants.3: Necropolis Regent and Thirsting Bloodlord, with Vicious Conquistador, Gift of Fangs and Go for the Throat
variants.4: Vampire Nighthawk and Rodolf Duskbringer, with Exsanguinate, Epicure of Blood and Moment of Craving

Warriors.description: A red Warrior pack that turns opposing creatures into Cowards that cannot block.
Warriors.plan: Attack every turn with Warriors while Gornog and Goma Fada Vanguard shut down blockers, and burn the rest away with Soul Sear and Pyrophobia.

variants.1: Expedition Champion, Kruin Striker and Boggart Brute, with Kindled Fury
variants.2: Kargan Intimidator and Daybreak Combatants, with Unstoppable Ogre and Infuriate

Wizards.description: A blue Wizard pack of creatures with useful enter-the-battlefield effects, led by Naban, who doubles them.
Wizards.plan: Play Wizards for card draw, bounce and tap effects, doubling them with Naban, and protect your lead with Remand and Starlight Snare.

variants.1: Archaeomancer and Exclusion Mage, with Cloudkin Seer, Concentrate, Choking Tethers and Windcaller Aven
variants.2: Aether Channeler and Frost Trickster, with Expedition Diviner, Chilling Trap, Opportunity and Shipwreck Dowser

Zealots.description: A red exert pack of Minotaurs and Jackals that push extra hard on the attack in exchange for skipping their next untap.
Zealots.plan: Exert attackers to make them bigger or stop blockers, refill with Anep and Battlefield Scavenger, and finish with Fling or Trial of Zeal.

variants.1: Zealous Conscripts and Ahn-Crop Crasher, with Emberhorn Minotaur, Nef-Crop Entangler, Brute Strength and Flame-Blessed Bolt
variants.2: Sandstorm Crasher and Ahn-Crop Crasher, with Zealot of the God-Pharaoh and Pathmaker Initiate
variants.3: Combat Celebrant for extra combats, with Trueheart Twins, Emberhorn Minotaur, Shock and Hearts on Fire
variants.4: Sandstorm Crasher and Zealous Conscripts, with Trueheart Twins, Minotaur Sureshot and Kindled Fury
